text:
Ava: Conflux reached out — they want a sandbox + joint marketplace tile + co-blog. Asking for LangChain + LlamaIndex support and a small hardware benchmark on SigmaGPU. Target public beta Apr 10. Can we support that timeline?

Raj: We need an eng smoke test for their gateway adapter. Is LangChain runner compatibility verified? @Erin any blockers?

Erin: Ran e2e yesterday. LangChain chains are fine. LlamaIndex requires a tokenizer mapping tweak for some embeddings; opened PR with fix branch `conflux-lindex-fix`. CI passed locally but one integration is flaky in CI.

Raj: Good. Any perf regressions on SigmaGPU quantized profiles? @Kim on ops side?

Kim: We can reserve 2 dedicated nodes for a week (edge pool). Need partner NDA for private repo access. Perf snapshot (internal): p50 ~45ms/token at 8k seq, bf16. I can run quantized runs if you want more numbers.

Edward (Conflux): We can sign NDA today. We'll also provide an anonymized test dataset and some sample prompts. Specs: https://conflux.dev/sandbox-specs

Ava: Marketing/gtm dependency — @Sam?

Sam: We can do a light co-announcement if adapter + compatibility badge are ready. Proposed assets: joint blog, short demo vid, marketplace tile. Need a stub PR for marketplace listing by Apr 3 to review assets.

Leo: Design can deliver marketplace tile + demo UI frames by Apr 1. Send copy + logos.

Erin: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/321 — includes adapter + test harness. CI is green except one flaky test.

Raj: Which test is flaky, paste the failing log?

Erin: ```
FAIL test_integration.py::test_prefix_cache - AssertionError: expected 12 tokens but got 8
Stack: tests/integration/test_integration.py:87
Cmd: pytest -k test_prefix_cache --maxfail=1 -q
```

Raj: I can debug tomorrow morning. @DeployBot can we spin a sandbox env to run the same test under the partner workload?

DeployBot: deploy scheduled: sandbox-conflux-1718736452 -> started. ETA ~20m. Jenkins job: https://ci.redwood/jenkins/234

LegalBot: NDA template ready in Confluence. @Ava confirm scope = sandbox access + analytics only?

Ava: Confirm scope = analytics + sandbox-only, no production data. Send NDA to Edward and ask for signed copy. I'll also draft a one-pager for co-marketing.

Edward (Conflux): NDA signed and uploaded. Sent sample dataset to the shared bucket. We'll aim to record the demo week of Apr 6.

Sam: Tentative plan: soft-launch to partner list Apr 10, public Apr 17 if tests/perf look good.

Kim: Reserved nodes in dedicated cluster Apr 5-12. Please schedule load tests Apr 8. Let me know expected qps and sequence lengths.

Ava: :thumbsup: I'll update the partner tracker (sheet + CRM). Recording: who will do the demo script?

Erin: I'll draft the demo script and include a short runbook for the sandbox.

Ava: Perfect. Anything else?

Erin: :rocket:

Sam: I'll create the marketplace stub PR and link it here once ready.
